name: claudemods
description: Small Claude Code mods: context and plan-usage gauges, a prompt-cache meter, and a pane of things to look at.

plugins.name: context-gauge
plugins.description: Context left, plus 5-hour and weekly plan usage with a reset countdown, on one line under the prompt; /gauge for a colour-coded context breakdown.

plugins.name: open-tray
plugins.description: POWERTRAY: things to look at or listen to (made this session, related to what you are on), an in-tray player, and a recap of big moves.

plugins.name: prompt-cache-control
plugins.description: Prompt-cache meter above the prompt: hit rate, a countdown to expiry and what to do about it; /cache for a per-turn table, /cache off|on to hide or show the bar.
